# Fanfarr v0.3.1

A fix for the Seasons column, which has never shown a number.

## The Seasons column was always empty

Plex reports how many seasons a show has (`childCount`) in the section
listing. Fanfarr read it, parsed it, and accepted it in the write action --
and neither of the two paths that write an item passed it on. So the column
existed, the library page could display it, and every show stored nothing.

Both paths pass it now: the section sync, and **Refresh** on a single item.

Films stay empty deliberately. Plex reports no season count for a movie, and
an empty cell is the answer rather than a zero.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart. Then run a sync -- **Sync now** in Settings, or
**Refresh** on one item -- to fill the column in. The numbers are read from
Plex, so they cannot be derived from what is already stored. No theme is
touched and nothing is downloaded again.
